author_name: สีดา อริศ
text:
Hey everyone 😊
I’m Arits from Thailand. I’ve been living in Israel for about 8 months now, but honestly I feel like my Hebrew hasn’t improved much. I’ve just been learning on my own and haven’t taken any classes.
Would love to hear from you guys any tips or ways that helped you improve your Hebrew? Especially if you learned by yourself! I really want to get more confident speaking Hebrew. Thanks so much in advance for any advice or experiences you can share.🙏❤️
